_about: Camera effects (hyperframes/camfx.js). id: cat, mood, what (when to use it), d (default seconds), sound [[sound id, at (fraction of d), volume]], hold (stays at the end state), cap (has a caption; default text in camfx.js).

zoom_punch.what: Instant punch-in on the face with a vine boom. THE meme zoom: a punch word, a reveal, a sus line.

crash_zoom.what: Fast motion-blurred zoom deep into the face, then snaps back. Sudden realisation, 'WAIT'.

dramatic_zoom.what: Slow push-in with darkening vignette (dun dun DUNNN). Dramatic reveal, bad news coming.

triple_zoom.what: Three stepped zooms, each with a boom ('what? WHAT? WHAAAT?!'). Escalating disbelief. Optional caption on the last hit (cap=).

rock_eyebrow.what: The Rock eyebrow-raise style: slow zoom, black & white, vignette, boom. After a sus or double-meaning line.

dark_zoom.what: Screen goes dark and the camera creeps in a little (Spider-Man meme). Something shady / hidden meaning.

zoom_out_reveal.what: Starts zoomed on the face and pulls back to reveal the whole scene. 'Turns out…' moments.

ken_burns.what: Slow documentary pan-and-zoom. Keeps a still or calm shot alive, storytelling.

mind_blown.what: Zoom builds up, then BOOM: white flash, speed lines, shake. Big-brain fact, mind blown.

shake.what: Simple camera shake. Emphasis on any loud or sudden line.

earthquake.what: Violent shake with blur and colour split. Explosion, huge news, rage.

impact_hit.what: One hard hit: flash + recoil shake. A punch line that lands, a slap of reality.

rage_vibrate.what: Fast vibrating red-tinted zoom. Pure rage, frustration.

bass_boosted.what: Deep-fried + earthquake + beat zoom pulses. 'Bass boosted' chaos, ear-rape style meme moment.

handheld.what: Gentle handheld drift. Makes static footage feel filmed; vlog / documentary feel.

heartbeat.what: Zoom pulses on a lub-dub beat with a red vignette. Tension, nervous, exam pressure.

whip_pan_left.what: Fast blurred whip to the left and back in. Transition, 'meanwhile…', changing topic.

whip_pan_right.what: Fast blurred whip to the right and back in. Transition between points.

spin_360.what: Full 360° spin with zoom dip. Transition, 'plot twist', silly energy.

dutch_tilt.what: Camera tilts sideways and zooms. Something isn't right, villain energy.

drunk_wobble.what: Wobbly, wavy, blurry dizzy camera. Confused, brain not working, too much maths.

upside_down.what: Flips upside down with a springy overshoot and back. Everything turned upside down, 'wait what'.

bounce_boing.what: Cartoon squash-and-stretch wobble. Goofy, silly line.

bonk_drop.what: The shot falls in from the top and lands with a BONK and squash. Dumb mistake, 'go to horny jail' energy.

deep_fry.what: Deep-fried meme look: crazy saturation/contrast, grain, 😂💯👌 emojis. Absurd or ironic moment.

freeze_gray.what: Record scratch + black & white + 'Yup. That's me.' (Freeze-frame look; to really freeze, pause/split the footage there.) Before explaining how we got here, or an ending.

sad_mode.what: Desaturated blue, vignette, slow zoom with sad violin. Failure, lost marks, sad news.

rainbow_party.what: Hue-cycling rainbow with beat zoom. Celebration, vibing, it worked.

flashbang.what: Blinding white flash that slowly clears. Too bright / overwhelming info, a flashbang of facts.

horror_flicker.what: Flickering dark grainy horror look with creeping zoom. Scary topic, exam tomorrow.

camera_flash.what: Photo flash snap. 'Screenshot this', remember this, iconic moment.

vhs.what: Old VHS tape: scanlines, colour bleed, tracking glitches, 'PLAY ▶'. Flashback, history, old method.

glitch_hit.what: Digital glitch burst: tearing, RGB split, inverted flicker. Error, brain.exe stopped, system failure.

rgb_split_hit.what: Quick chromatic-aberration hit. Subtle punch on a key word.

tv_off.what: Old CRT TV switching off (collapses to a line, then a dot). Ending, 'I'm out', end of discussion. Holds black.

anime_speedlines.what: Anime speed lines burst around the face with a punch-in. Hype, intense realisation, power-up.

sus_red.what: Among-Us red pulsing vignette, slow zoom and 'SUS'. Something doesn't add up.

red_alert.what: Red alarm flashing with a slight shake. Warning, common mistake, 'don't do this'.

cinematic_bars.what: Black letterbox bars slide in, teal-orange film look. Epic serious moment, 'and that's when it started'.

spotlight.what: Everything goes dark except a circle on the focus point. Point at one thing, 'look at THIS'.

emotional_damage.what: Red flash, zoom, shake and 'EMOTIONAL DAMAGE!'. After a savage roast or a brutal fact.

thug_life.what: Black-and-white zoom with 'THUG LIFE'. Savage answer, confident flex.

dream_wavy.what: Wavy dreamy blur with a soft white glow. Flashback, imagination, daydreaming.
